scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.test:e2e: node e2e/start-server.test.js && npm run build && playwright test
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.db:migrate: node -e "const cmd = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'npm run db:migrate:deploy --prefix server' : 'npm run db:migrate --prefix server'; require('child_process').execSync(cmd, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
